/* basket */
function playBasket(){
 const s=$('#stage');s.innerHTML=`<div class="scene basketScene"><div class="skyGrad"></div><div class="marketAwning"></div><div class="marketSign">싱싱 청과</div><div class="stallBack"></div><div class="stallShelf"></div><div class="produceTray trayL">🍎🥬🍊</div><div class="produceTray trayR">🥕🍓🍐</div></div><div class="counter" id="tm">35</div><div class="comboHud" id="combo">COMBO ×0</div><div class="lifeHud" id="life">❤️❤️❤️</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="playCoinHud" id="playCoinHud">🪙 +0</div><div class="gameTip">LEVEL 3부터 좌우 흔들림 · LEVEL 4부터 2개 동시낙하 · 동전은 실제 코인 보너스!</div><img class="catchOso" src="${currentOsoSrc()}" alt="오소"><div class="basket"></div>`;
 let score=0,t=35,alive=true,items=[],x=.5,last=0,raf,combo=0,lives=3,level=1,bonusCoins=0,prev=performance.now();const basket=$('.basket'),oso=$('.catchOso');
 function setX(px){const r=s.getBoundingClientRect();x=Math.max(.14,Math.min(.86,(px-r.left)/r.width));let q=x*r.width;basket.style.left=(q-62)+'px';oso.style.left=(q-52)+'px'}
 let r0=s.getBoundingClientRect();setX(r0.left+r0.width/2);s.onpointermove=e=>setX(e.clientX);s.onpointerdown=e=>setX(e.clientX);
 function hud(){$('#combo').textContent=`COMBO ×${combo}`;$('#life').textContent='❤️'.repeat(lives)+'🖤'.repeat(3-lives);const c=$('#playCoinHud');if(c)c.textContent=`🪙 +${bonusCoins}`} 
 function spawn(){let count=level>=4&&Math.random()<.4?2:1;for(let j=0;j<count;j++){let roll=Math.random(),bomb=.07+level*.015,kind=roll<bomb?'bomb':roll<bomb+.08?'coin':'good',el=document.createElement('div');el.className='falling popIn';el.textContent=kind==='bomb'?'💣':kind==='coin'?'🪙':['🍎','🥬','🍊','🥕','🍓','🍐'][Math.floor(Math.random()*6)];el.dataset.kind=kind;el.dataset.x=.07+Math.random()*.86;el.dataset.y=-.08-j*.07;el.dataset.v=.27+level*.045+Math.random()*.08;el.dataset.phase=Math.random()*6.28;s.appendChild(el);items.push(el)}}
 let ti=setInterval(()=>{t--;$('#tm').textContent=t;if(t<=0){alive=false;clearInterval(ti);cancelAnimationFrame(raf);finish('basket',score,playBasket,true,bonusCoins)}},1000);
 function loop(ts){if(!alive)return;let dt=Math.min(.033,(ts-prev)/1000);prev=ts,r=s.getBoundingClientRect();if(ts-last>Math.max(210,610-level*75)){spawn();last=ts}items.forEach(el=>{let y=+el.dataset.y+(+el.dataset.v)*dt,xp=+el.dataset.x;if(level>=3)xp+=Math.sin(y*12+(+el.dataset.phase))*.0011;el.dataset.x=xp;el.dataset.y=y;el.style.left=(xp*r.width-20)+'px';el.style.top=(y*r.height)+'px';el.style.transform=`rotate(${y*220}deg)`;if(y>.76&&y<.92&&Math.abs(xp-x)<.16){let br=basket.getBoundingClientRect(),cx=br.left+br.width/2,cy=br.top;if(el.dataset.kind==='bomb'){lives--;combo
